base_url.description: Tenant-specific Marketo host root URL, for example https://123-ABC-456.mktorest.com. Do not include /rest/v1; connector definitions add documented paths.

access_token.description: Marketo REST API access token supplied by the caller. This connector does not perform OAuth token issuance or refresh.

mode.description: Runtime mode: live or fixture for credential-free conformance.

id.description: Required path parameter id for Marketo stream get_email_by_id.

folder.description: JSON representation of parent folder, with members 'id', and 'type' which may be 'Folder' or 'Program'

program_id.description: Required path parameter programId for Marketo stream get_smart_list_by_program_id.

export_id.description: Required path parameter exportId for Marketo stream get_export_activities_status.

api_name.description: Required path parameter apiName for Marketo stream get_import_custom_object_status.

batch_id.description: Required path parameter batchId for Marketo stream get_import_custom_object_status.

activity_type_ids.description: Comma-separated list of activity type ids. These can be retrieved with the Get Activity Types API.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of field names to return changes for. Field names can be retrieved with the Describe Lead API.

since_datetime.description: Earliest datetime to retrieve activities from

campaign_id.description: Required path parameter campaignId for Marketo stream get_campaign_by_id.

filter_type.description: The company field to filter on. Searchable fields can be retrieved with the Describe Company call.

filter_values.description: Comma-separated list of values to match against

custom_object_name.description: Required path parameter customObjectName for Marketo stream get_custom_objects.

lead_id.description: Required path parameter leadId for Marketo stream get_lead_by_id.

list_id.description: Required path parameter listId for Marketo stream get_leads_by_list_id.

userid.description: Required path parameter userid for Marketo stream get_user_roles_and_workspaces.

next_page_token.description: Initial Marketo paging token for activity, lead-change, and deleted-lead streams. Obtain with get_activities_paging_token.
